thread:
Maya (Support): SparrowCo filed an urgent report: sudden spike in 5xxs and throughput collapse during their traffic burst around 09:12 UTC. They saw timeouts and ~10% 503s.
Liam (Sales): They are in the enterprise pilot with SLOs. They've escalated to our account team. Looping in @Nadia (PM) for prioritization.
Nadia (PM): Thanks. Maya, can you paste the route, model, and representative payload? Also confirm region and approximate concurrency. Need to know whether to treat as infra/regression.
Maya (Support): Route: /v1/generate (sparrowco-prod). Model: gpt-xlarge-quant. Typical seq ~600, client concurrency ~140. Sample payload below. They included timing showing the regression right after last deploy window.
```
POST /v1/generate
{ "model": "gpt-xlarge-quant", "input": "~500 tokens" }
=> 503 {"error":"instance overload"}
```
Rohit (Eng): Initial telemetry: autoscaler activity + pod restarts in eu-west-1 pool-5 at ~09:10. Memory pressure + kernel-level scheduling change were rolled as part of v2026.07.18.09. I see increased mem residency on large-kv paths.
Ivy (Oncall): Confirming OOM events around same time. Several pods restarted due to GPU OOM and kube OOMKills. Also saw increased queueing on nginx ingress.
deploybot: Rollout v2026.07.18.09 -> pool-5 applied at 2026-07-18T09:05:00Z
Liam (Sales): Customer timeline matches that deploy. SparrowCo requests either immediate safe mitigation (non-disruptive) or a rollback with timeline. They want minimal quality regression.
Nadia (PM): Triage options: (1) Apply per-route override to force a lower-memory model variant (gpt-xlarge-fp16) as a temporary fallback. (2) Route SparrowCo traffic to a dedicated EU pool if capacity can be provisioned quickly. (3) Rollback the kernel scheduling change globally. We need to balance risk to other customers.
Rohit (Eng): Pros/cons: fallback -> quick, minor output diff; dedicated pool -> good perf but provisioning ~45m; rollback -> safest for this regression but touches many pools and takes ~1h with risk.
Maya (Support): SparrowCo prefers a quick config change over a rollback. They requested a canary so they can validate output quality before full switch.
Nadia (PM): Decision: execute config fallback + 100-request canary (split 10/90) for 15m, measure p95 and error rate. If stable, flip to 100% and keep under observation for 2 hours. Action owners: Rohit to push route override, Ivy to monitor infra and alerts, Maya to coordinate with customer, Liam to draft customer comms.
Rohit (Eng): Pushing route override now: `PATCH /v1/routes/sparrowco-prod` body: `{ "model_override": "gpt-xlarge-fp16", "canary_pct": 10, "canary_requests": 100 }` (applying).
Ivy (Oncall): I configured a temporary alert: `sparrowco_error_rate > 2% for 1m` -> page eng-oncall. Watching node OOM and ingress latency.
Maya (Support): Ran the canary; customer reports initial 100 requests: p95 ~310ms, error rate 0.7% (down from 10%). They requested we keep them updated hourly and would like a postmortem.
Liam (Sales): I've told them we executed a fallback and are monitoring. They've asked for ETA for root cause and concrete remediation timeline before the end of week.
Nadia (PM): Backlog commitments and acceptance criteria:
- P0 RCA ticket: reproduce mem spike with scheduled kernel heuristic + high concurrency. Owner: Rohit. Due: 72h. Acceptance: reproducible test case + plan for patch and perf benchmark showing no regression.
- P1: Per-route auto-fallback feature spec (product): owner Nadia. Due: 2 sprints. Acceptance: product doc + small prototype that can toggle to compatible variants under mem pressure.
- P1: Runbook update for deploy rollback and per-customer mitigation steps: owner Ivy. Due: 5 days. Acceptance: clear runbook + escalation matrix.
- P2: SLA impact assessment + customer credit calc: owner Liam. Due: 24h.
Rohit (Eng): Created ticket RF-4321. Short-term: keep override in place for 2 hours, then evaluate. I'll add logs and heap dumps to the ticket and work on a reproducer in staging.
deploybot: RF-4321 created by rohit (Eng)
Nadia (PM): Customer-facing resolution criteria:
- SparrowCo p95 < 400ms and error rate < 1% for 2 continuous hours
- RCA delivered and a timeline for the production fix scheduled
- Per-route mitigation product spec created and prioritized in roadmap
Maya (Support): Logged follow-up with SparrowCo in 1 hour and set expectations.
Ivy (Oncall): If error rate creeps above 2% I'll escalate to eng runtime and consider temporary capacity move.
Liam (Sales): Noted. I'll prepare a concise status email to SparrowCo now and include next steps and SLA update.
Nadia (PM): Thanks team. We'll treat the RCA as P0 and the auto-fallback feature as the roadmap outcome from this incident. Keep updates here. :white_check_mark:
